ValidationRule.description: V-INC-05: Blocks case stage advancement past Finance Review Incoming when Finance Cleared is Open or Hold. Finance must update status to Cleared or Partially Cleared before the case can progress.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status) && TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status)) != 'Draft' && TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status)) == 'Finance Review Incoming' && (ISPICKVAL(Finance_Cleared__c, 'Open') || ISPICKVAL(Finance_Cleared__c, 'Hold'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Finance clearance must be updated (Cleared or Partially Cleared) before advancing from Finance Review Incoming. Finance Cleared is currently Open or Hold.
